properties.description: Two Rust tests over the served tool list (tools/list, with its list-time decorations). (1) a_served_description_names_only_arguments_its_tool_takes.rs reads every served tool's description and every `description` string in its input schema for three shapes that say "argument" in their grammar: "`tool` with `a`" (and a list after it), "`tool`'s `a` argument/parameter", and a JSON example after a tool's name in the same clause (the word introducing it is an argument of the tool, and its keys are that argument's items' properties, or the tool's own with no introducing word). Each named argument must be a property of that tool's served input schema; the test also fails if fewer than 64 names are read, so the reader cannot go quiet, and `the_check_sees_every_shape_it_names` pins each shape both ways on real sentences, including the 2026-10-26 "`draw_edges`, items {…}" sentence. (2) a_bulk_edge_write_keeps_each_helpers_checks.rs::the_bulk_sentence_names_only_what_draw_edges_takes reads the generated bulk sentence on every typed edge helper as an agent would and SENDS that exact call to draw_edges with check_only, which must be taken. Looser readings (any tool name followed by a backticked word) were measured and rejected: 16 of 24 pairs were reply fields, gap kinds or values. Not read: "pass `x`" (names a value as often as an argument), skills, and names inside an argument beyond their root.
properties.findings: On main fb9286c46 (old sentence) both tests FAIL, each naming 32 helpers whose description names `draw_edges` with `items`; the general check found nothing else on the 199-tool surface. With the fix, 12/12 pass (cargo test -p reflow2-mcp --no-default-features --test in_memory, 2026-10-26).
properties.name: A served description names only arguments its tool takes
